title: Local DVR square and rational presentation for a root of a unit
statement: Let A and T be discrete valuation ring domains [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], and let T be a local A-algebra. Let e>0 be a natural number invertible in A, and let v be a unit in A. There exist DVR domains A' and T', local algebra maps A->A', T->T' and A'->T' forming a commuting square, and r in A' with r^e equal to the image of v. The residue extension k(A')/k(A) is separable [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension], and T->T' is injective. For every x in T', there are polynomials p,q in T[X] such that q(r_T) is nonzero and x*q(r_T)=p(r_T), where r_T is the image of r in T'. No fraction field is part of this statement.

source.place: Tag 0BRM, first claim of the proof; the local unit-root square, with the localization fraction presentation made explicit.

proof.text: Put C=A[X]/(X^e-v) and D=T[X]/(X^e-v_T). The positive exponent makes D finite free and faithful over T. The integral lying-over theorem chooses a maximal ideal q of D contracting to m_T. The coefficient-induced map phi:C->D takes the root to the root. Contract q to p in C. Commutativity on coefficients and locality of A->T give p contracted to A equals m_A.

Apply [lem-sbc-dvr-unit-root-at-prime] over A at p and over T at q (mapping invertibility of e to T). This gives DVR domains A'=C_p and T'=D_q, the local horizontal maps, the separable residue extension for A'/A, and injectivity of T->T'. The localization map associated to phi gives the local vertical map A'->T'. Its equality on C proves commutativity of the square and identifies the two root images. The defining root relation gives r^e=v.

For x in D_q, use the localization fraction presentation x=a/b with b outside q. Choose polynomial representatives for a and b by surjectivity of the AdjoinRoot quotient. Polynomial evaluation commutes with the map to D_q and the root identification. The image of b is a unit, hence nonzero; the localization fraction equation then yields x*q(r)=p(r).

proof_origin.place: Tag 0BRM, first claim; explicit root algebras, lying over, localRingHom and polynomial quotient representatives.

lean.statement:
theorem dvr_unit_root_local_square
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    (e : ℕ) (hepos : 0 < e) (he : IsUnit (e : A)) (v : Aˣ)
    (T : Type u) [CommRing T] [IsDomain T] [IsDiscreteValuationRing T]
    [Algebra A T] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A T)] :
    ∃ (A' : Type u) (_ : CommRing A') (_ : IsDomain A')
      (_ : IsDiscreteValuationRing A') (aAA' : Algebra A A'),
    letI := aAA'
    ∃ (hAA' : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A A')) (r : A'),
    letI := hAA'
    r ^ e = algebraMap A A' (v : A) ∧
    Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A') ∧
    ∃ (T' : Type u) (_ : CommRing T') (_ : IsDomain T')
      (_ : IsDiscreteValuationRing T') (aTT' : Algebra T T') (aA'T' : Algebra A' T'),
    letI := aTT'
    letI := aA'T'
    ∃ (_ : IsLocalHom (algebraMap T T')) (_ : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A' T')),
    (∀ a : A, algebraMap T T' (algebraMap A T a) =
      algebraMap A' T' (algebraMap A A' a)) ∧
    Function.Injective (algebraMap T T') ∧
    ∀ x : T', ∃ p q : Polynomial T,
      q.eval₂ (algebraMap T T') (algebraMap A' T' r) ≠ 0 ∧
      x * q.eval₂ (algebraMap T T') (algebraMap A' T' r) =
        p.eval₂ (algebraMap T T') (algebraMap A' T' r)
